# Route X4 — Agent runtime/protocol (A2A, ADK) and Arize Phoenix, delta as of 2026-10-08

Baseline read first per instructions: `/Users/balla/Desktop/satvik/2026 Fall/Challenge X/TechnoMile Agentic Black Hat/docs/research/external/E11-agent-frameworks-durability-streaming.md` (2026-09-25) and `E12-phoenix-observability-evals.md` (2026-09-25). Reports what is new/arena-specific 13 days later. Method: Context7 CLI, Google Developer Knowledge (GDK), WebSearch, plus direct PyPI JSON reads for ground-truth versions (logged separately).

Also read: `docs/research/BRIEF.md` and `docs/challenge/REQUIREMENTS.md` in the Unissant Agent Training Arena project. Requirement IDs (BKO-6/7/9, AST-*, SCN-*, EVL-*) cited per the brief.

## Q1. A2A protocol
A2A reached spec v1.0 (frozen 2026-03-12: signed Agent Cards, multitenancy, version negotiation, multi-protocol bindings); became an Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation) hosted project 2026-08-17, 150+ supporting orgs [Linux Foundation press release, 2026-08-17]. Python a2a-sdk is 1.2.2 (2026-10-05, PyPI). Current Agent Card proto (Context7, a2a-protocol.org/latest/definitions, 2026-10-08): name, description, url, preferred_transport, additional_interfaces, provider, version, capabilities{streaming,push_notifications,extensions}, security_schemes, security, default_input/output_modes, skills, supports_authenticated_extended_card, signatures, icon_url — contradicts an older supportedInterfaces/securityRequirements JSON example on the same site. Three transports: JSON-RPC, gRPC, HTTP+JSON. Update delivery: polling (Get Task), streaming (Send Streaming Message/Subscribe to Task, needs capabilities.streaming=true — fits the arena's live coaching), push/webhooks. TaskState enum: SUBMITTED, WORKING, COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELED/REJECTED (terminal), INPUT_REQUIRED/AUTH_REQUIRED (interrupted). Per-hop latency overhead: not quantified by any primary source reached. Security for untrusted remote agents: every remote agent treated as a standard HTTP enterprise app with no built-in caller identity; HTTPS mandatory, OAuth2-style external credentials, signed Agent Cards (v1.0), authenticated-only Extended Agent Card (spec §13.3) that must not leak sensitive info. Cloud Run now has a (Preview) first-class A2A deploy path (--functional-type=agent --identity-type=agent-identity, in-memory or AlloyDB TaskStore, a2a-inspector compliance tool) — new since baseline. ADK's to_a2a()/RemoteA2aAgent auto-detect a2a-sdk 0.3.x vs 1.x.x. Weighing (inputs only): A2A-for-every-candidate gives uniform isolation and true external-agent support at the cost of a per-turn hop (unmeasured) and a second attack surface; in-process interface + A2A adapter at the boundary keeps the common path simple while still accepting BYO entrants via to_a2a/RemoteA2aAgent. No source compares these for a bake-off specifically.

## Q2. Google ADK (Python)
Version verified directly: google-adk 2.11.0 (2026-10-02, PyPI), up two minors from baseline's 2.9.2. openinference-instrumentation-google-adk jumped 0.1.28→1.0.3 (2026-10-08, same day); openinference-instrumentation-google-genai is 1.4.11 (2026-10-07, up from 1.4.7). A2A integration matches baseline with more detail: to_a2a(root_agent, port=...) auto-generates an Agent Card from ADK metadata; RemoteA2aAgent consumes a remote card; SDK major-version auto-detected. output_schema+tools: current adk.dev doc shows an unqualified working LlmAgent(tools=[...], output_schema=Model) example on gemini-2.5-flash — contradicts the 2026-09-25 baseline's "reliable only on Gemini 3.x, else unreliable set_model_response fallback" finding; not reconciled, flagged as must-verify-hands-on before AST-7 depends on it. Callbacks (before/after_agent, before/after_model) and session-state persistence timing confirmed via a sample's own runtime assertions. Streaming (LiveRequestQueue, RunConfig SSE) matches baseline. Evaluation: evalset files (EvalSet/EvalCase Pydantic models) support multi-turn sessions with optional ConversationScenario-driven user simulation; four run paths (adk web, pytest, adk eval CLI, adk conformance); 12 built-in criteria incl. rubric_based_multi_turn_trajectory_quality_v1 (custom rubrics, majority-voted LLM judge — closest fit to EVL-7's five-dimension rubric), per_turn_user_simulator_quality_v1 (checks a simulated subject's fidelity to persona/plan — maps to SUB-4/6/8), and four always-on efficiency criteria (tool/inference call counts, token usage, invocation duration — gives EVL-5 for free). BKO-6 (replay) fits ADK evalsets/Phoenix datasets closely; BKO-7 (interactive) fits per_turn_user_simulator_quality_v1 for the subject side, but the bespoke interviewer-harness relay (7N.3) is not provided by either framework. Caveat: multi_turn_task_success_v1/trajectory/tool_use_v1 delegate to the Vertex AI Agent Platform Eval SDK, requiring a GCP project — not pure-ADK. OpenTelemetry tracing: native via maybe_set_otel_providers()/--otel_to_cloud; spans invoke_agent/generate_content/call_llm/execute_tool; attributes incl. gcp.vertex.agent.*; privacy default ADK_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT_IN_SPANS=false is automatic only on `adk deploy agent_engine --otel_to_cloud`, must be set explicitly on Cloud Run/GKE. Deployment — the key finding: Vertex AI Agent Engine min_instances ranges [0,10], default 1; Google's own docs recommend min_instances>=1 (even =10) to cut cold-start latency ~4.7s→~1.4s, directly in tension with the owner's hard gate; a provisional doc statement says idle time above min_instances=0 is currently unbilled during Preview but "subject to change" — not a durable scale-to-zero guarantee. Cloud Run deployment of an ADK agent remains a plain `gcloud run deploy --source .` flow with ordinary Cloud Run scale-to-zero semantics (per the E11/E12 baseline), and stays the safer default.

## Q3. Arize Phoenix
Version verified directly: arize-phoenix 20.19.0 (2026-10-01, PyPI), arize-phoenix-otel 0.17.2 (2026-09-28) — three minor server releases past baseline's 20.16.0, consistent with baseline's observed churn rate. Tracing/sessions API unchanged. Annotations: SpanAnnotationData(annotator_kind="HUMAN", result={label,score}, metadata) logged via phoenix_client.spans.log_span_annotations — a workable mechanism for BKO-9's blinded trainer-review queue, but Phoenix itself does not enforce blinding of the evaluator-only packet (SCN-9) from the reviewer; that must be built at the application layer. Datasets/experiments (run_experiment, splits, repetitions) unchanged, fits the replay track (BKO-6) and BKO-10's repeated-run clustering. Evals (FaithfulnessEvaluator, HallucinationEvaluator, ClassificationEvaluator) unchanged; any Gemini-only judge call must explicitly pass provider="google" per the baseline's finding. Deployment on Supabase/Cloud Run (pgbouncer session-pooler requirement, BulkInserter span-loss risk at idle, schema-exposure hazard) unchanged, not re-verified this session. OpenInference instrumentors: google-genai 1.4.11 (2026-10-07, up from 1.4.7); google-adk jumped a major version to 1.0.3 (2026-10-08) from baseline's 0.1.28 — the single most significant instrumentor delta found, flagged as a hard prerequisite to re-check before pinning. A2A tracing support: checked directly — openinference-instrumentation-a2a returns PyPI 404 (does not exist), and no Phoenix documentation mentions A2A spans or semantic conventions. No first-party A2A instrumentor or native Phoenix A2A tracing exists today; any A2A-hop tracing must be hand-instrumented as manual spans.

## Contradictions
1. ADK output_schema+tools reliability (Gemini-3.x-only per baseline vs. an unqualified gemini-2.5-flash example today) — unreconciled.
2. A2A Agent Card "current shape" — an older JSON example vs. the canonical proto on the same docs site.
3. Vertex AI Agent Engine's own optimization guidance (min_instances>=1, even =10) vs. the owner's hard scale-to-zero gate; the "no idle billing" claim is explicitly Preview-only.
4. A secondary WebSearch-synthesized "A2A v1.0.1, May 2026" claim, uncorroborated against a primary changelog this session.

## Open questions
Per-hop A2A latency (unmeasured); whether the ADK output_schema+tools finding reflects a real 2.9→2.11 capability change; what changed in openinference-instrumentation-google-adk's 0.1.28→1.0.3 jump; whether the baseline's google-genai instrumentor bugs (#3788, #3813) were fixed in 1.4.7→1.4.11; durability of Agent Engine's "no idle billing" Preview claim; whether arize-phoenix-evals moved past 3.9.0; whether an A2A hop can be traced via the Cloud Trace GenAI semconv bridge absent an OpenInference A2A instrumentor.

## Implications (no recommendation)
A2A-for-BYO-agent is closer to turnkey than the baseline suggested (Cloud Run's Preview A2A deploy path, to_a2a/RemoteA2aAgent SDK-version smoothing). Any Agent Engine use needs an explicit scale-to-zero sign-off decision, since its own docs default to and recommend min_instances>=1; Cloud Run remains the safer default. AST-7's schema-enforced flag is gated on resolving the output_schema+tools contradiction via a hands-on smoke test. BKO-6 fits ADK evalsets/Phoenix datasets well; BKO-7 fits ADK's user-simulator criterion for the subject side but the interviewer-harness relay is bespoke regardless of framework. Phoenix annotations can carry BKO-9's blinded review but blinding enforcement is an application-layer responsibility, not a Phoenix feature. No A2A tracing exists anywhere in the Phoenix/OpenInference ecosystem today — budget manual instrumentation if A2A is adopted. Both ecosystems moved fast enough in just 13 days (3 Phoenix releases, an ADK instrumentor major bump) that any pinned version should be re-verified near the actual bake-off date.
